scheme_name: IVRI Institute Scholarship For M.V.Sc. And Ph.D.
other_conditions: Admission must be through a competitive entrance examination for MVSc/PhD programmes
Applicants must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST or sponsored candidates)

PhD applicants must hold an MVSc degree with minimum CGPA of 6.50/10 (General/OBC) or 5.50/10 (SC/ST/physically‑challenged/sponsored) or equivalent marks (60% for General/OBC, 50% for SC/ST/physically‑challenged/sponsored)
Scholarship recipients must maintain a CGPA of 7.00 out of 10 at the end of each semester for Masters or Doctoral programmes
Minimum qualifying marks in the entrance examination are 50% for General candidates, 48% for OBC candidates, and 45% for SC/ST candidates
benefits_summary: Masters scholars receive ₹7,560 per month for two years plus a ₹6,000 per annum contingent grant; PhD scholars receive ₹13,125 per month for three years plus a ₹10,000 per annum contingent grant.
